Section: Setup New App - Modal UI Elements
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application" button under Option B
2. Observe the modal that opens
Expected Result: Modal with heading "New application" opens. Fields visible: App name (required, placeholder "e.g., Samplepart 1"), App number, OEM, Program, Volume (number), Batch size (number), Material. Buttons: Add fastener, Cancel, Save. × close button visible.

Section: Setup New App - Save With Name Only (Happy Path)
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Fill app-name with "Test App Auto"
3. Click "Save"
Expected Result: Modal closes. Application appears in Applications section with name "Test App Auto". Option B shows "Selected: Test App Auto" with "Reset application" button. "No application selected." text disappears.

Section: Setup New App - Save With All Fields (Happy Path)
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Fill: name="Full Test App", app-no="FULL-001", OEM="BMW", program="X-Series", volume=200000, batch-size=1000, material="Aluminum EN AW-6082 T6"
3. Click "Save"
Expected Result: Modal closes. App card shows name "Full Test App" with details: App No.: FULL-001, 200,000 pcs/year. Portfolio totals update: Total annual volume = 200,000. Parts/year = 200,000.

Section: Setup New App - Required Field Validation (Empty Name)
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Leave app-name empty
3. Click "Save"
Expected Result: Save is prevented. Modal remains open. Either error message shown for required field, or Save button is disabled until name is entered. Application is NOT created.

Section: Setup New App - Negative Volume Validation
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Fill name="Valid Name", volume=-100
3. Click "Save"
Expected Result: Negative volume is rejected. Either input prevents entry of negative values, OR error message is shown, OR modal remains open. Application is NOT created with invalid data.

Section: Setup New App - Zero Volume Edge Case
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Fill name="Zero Volume App", volume=0
3. Click "Save"
Expected Result: Zero volume is either accepted (app created) or rejected with validation. Document the behavior.

Section: Setup New App - Zero Batch Size Edge Case
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Fill name="Zero Batch", batch-size=0
3. Click "Save"
Expected Result: Zero batch size is either accepted or rejected with validation error. Document the behavior.

Section: Setup New App - Extremely Large Volume
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Fill name="Large Volume", volume=999999999 (very large number)
3. Click "Save"
Expected Result: Large volume is either accepted (with formatted display) or rejected. Check if number formatting works for large values.

Section: Setup New App - Cancel Closes Modal Without Saving
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Fill name="Cancel Test", app-number="CANCEL-001"
3. Click "Cancel"
Expected Result: Modal closes. No application is created. Option B still shows "No application selected.".

Section: Setup New App - × Close Button Closes Modal
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Fill some fields
3. Click × close button
Expected Result: Modal closes. No application is created. Page returns to previous state.

Section: Setup New App - ESC Key Closes Modal
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Press Escape key
Expected Result: Modal closes. No application is created. Document if ESC key dismisses the modal.

Section: Setup New App - Add Single Fastener
Precondition: User has new app modal open
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Fill name="With Fastener"
3. In fastener section: select brand (e.g., PEM from react-select), enter type="SS", qtyA=4, qtyB=2
4. Click "Add fastener"
5. Click "Save"
Expected Result: Application is created with fastener. Fastener details appear in app card or in edit form.

Section: Setup New App - Add Multiple Fasteners
Precondition: User has new app modal open
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Fill name="Multi Fastener App"
3. Add first fastener (brand=PEM, type=SS, qtyA=4, qtyB=2) via Add fastener
4. Add second fastener (brand=SHEREX, type=CLS, qtyA=6, qtyB=3)
5. Click "Save"
Expected Result: Application created with 2 fasteners. Both fastener entries are persisted and visible in edit mode.

Section: Setup New App - Remove Fastener Before Save
Precondition: User has added a fastener in new app modal
Test Steps:
1. Add a fastener during setup
2. Click remove/delete on the fastener entry
3. Click "Save"
Expected Result: Fastener is removed. Application is created without the deleted fastener. Document if remove button exists on fastener rows.

Section: Setup New App - Auto-Sets Filters After Save
Precondition: User is on installation-system page with no application
Test Steps:
1. Record initial matching product count
2. Click "Setup New Application"
3. Fill name="Filter Test App" (with PEM-relevant data implied)
4. Click "Save"
Expected Result: Option B shows "Selected: Filter Test App". Element types filter chip auto-updates based on application. Matching product count changes. "Reset application" button appears.

Section: Setup New App - Portfolio Updates After Save
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Fill name="Portfolio App", volume=150000, batch-size=500
3. Click "Save"
4. Observe portfolio KPIs
Expected Result: Portfolio totals show: Total annual volume = 150,000. Parts/year = 150,000. Other KPIs may show calculated values.

Section: Edit App - Open Edit Form With Pre-filled Values
Test Steps:
1. Create an app "Edit Test App" with volume=50000
2. Click "Edit" button on the app card
3. Verify form opens
Expected Result: Edit modal opens with heading "Edit:" followed by app name. All fields are pre-populated with saved values.

Section: Edit App - Modify And Save
Test Steps:
1. In edit form, change name to "Updated Edit App" and volume to 75000
2. Click "Save"
Expected Result: App card updates: name shows "Updated Edit App", volume shows 75,000. Changes are persisted.

Section: Edit App - Cancel Edit Preserves Original Values
Precondition: User has edit modal open with changes
Test Steps:
1. Open edit, change name to "Changed Name"
2. Click "Cancel" without saving
Expected Result: Edit modal closes. App card still shows original name. Changes are NOT saved.

Section: Edit App - Add Fastener to Existing App
Precondition: User has an existing app without fasteners
Test Steps:
1. Create app "No Fastener Yet"
2. Click "Edit" on the app card
3. Add a fastener (brand=PEM, type=SS, qtyA=2, qtyB=1)
4. Click "Save"
Expected Result: Fastener is added to existing app. When editing again, the fastener is visible.

Section: Edit App - Remove Fastener from Existing App
Precondition: User has an existing app with fasteners
Test Steps:
1. Create app with a fastener
2. Click Edit, remove the fastener entry
3. Click Save
Expected Result: Fastener is removed from the app. App card no longer shows fastener info.

Section: Remove App - Single App
Test Steps:
1. Create an app "Remove Test App"
2. Click "Remove" button on the app card
Expected Result: Application is removed. "No application selected." returns. Option B shows original buttons. Portfolio totals reset to "—". Filters reset.

Section: Remove App - One of Multiple Apps
Test Steps:
1. Create "Keep This App" and "Remove This App"
2. Click "Remove" on "Remove This App"
Expected Result: One app removed. Other app remains. Portfolio totals recalculate. Applications count decreases.

Section: Reset Application - Deselect Without Deleting
Test Steps:
1. Create "Reset Test App"
2. Click "Reset application" button under Option B
Expected Result: Filters reset to defaults. "No application selected." returns. App card still visible in Applications section (app is NOT deleted, just deselected).

Section: Use Existing App - Modal UI Elements
Precondition: User has at least one saved app
Test Steps:
1. Click "Use Existing Application" under Option B
2. Observe the modal
Expected Result: Modal with heading "My applications" opens. Table visible with columns: Select (checkbox), Name, App No., OEM, Program, Company, Owner, Actions (Edit, Delete). Buttons: Select all, New application, Refresh, Close, OK.

Section: Use Existing App - Select And Load
Precondition: User has existing apps in the system
Test Steps:
1. Click "Use Existing Application"
2. Check checkbox of one app
3. Click "OK"
Expected Result: Modal closes. Selected app loads into Applications section. App card shows the app details. Option B shows "Selected: {app name}". Portfolio totals and filters auto-update.

Section: Use Existing App - Select Multiple Apps
Precondition: User has existing apps in the system
Test Steps:
1. Click "Use Existing Application"
2. Check multiple app checkboxes
3. Click "OK"
Expected Result: Multiple apps load into Applications section. Multiple app cards appear. Portfolio totals combine both apps.

Section: Use Existing App - Select All
Test Steps:
1. Click "Use Existing Application"
2. Click "Select all" button
3. Verify checkboxes
4. Click "OK"
Expected Result: All rows become checked automatically. After OK, all apps load into the section.

Section: Use Existing App - New Application From Modal
Precondition: User has Use Existing modal open
Test Steps:
1. Click "Use Existing Application"
2. Click "New application" button within the modal
Expected Result: Modal switches to the Setup New Application form. User can create a new app from this entry point. Same fields and behavior.

Section: Use Existing App - Edit From Modal
Precondition: User has Use Existing modal open with apps
Test Steps:
1. Click "Use Existing Application"
2. Click "Edit" in a row's Actions column
3. Modify fields in edit form
4. Click "Save"
Expected Result: Edit form opens with pre-filled values. After save, the table row updates. Changes are persisted.

Section: Use Existing App - Delete From Modal
Precondition: User has Use Existing modal open with apps
Test Steps:
1. Click "Use Existing Application"
2. Click "Delete" in a row's Actions column
3. Confirm deletion
Expected Result: The app is deleted from the system. Row disappears from table. If it was loaded in params section, it is removed from there too.

Section: Use Existing App - Refresh List
Precondition: User has Use Existing modal open
Test Steps:
1. Click "Use Existing Application"
2. Click "Refresh" button
Expected Result: The application list refreshes. Newly created apps appear in the table.

Section: Use Existing App - Close Without Selecting
Precondition: User has Use Existing modal open
Test Steps:
1. Click "Use Existing Application"
2. Click "Close" button or × close button
Expected Result: Modal closes. No app is selected. Page returns to previous state with "No application selected." visible.

Section: Use Existing App - Empty Table State
Precondition: User has no existing apps in the system
Test Steps:
1. Log in as a fresh user with no apps
2. Click "Use Existing Application"
3. Observe the table
Expected Result: Table shows empty state: "No applications found" or similar message. Buttons (New application, Close) are still visible.

Section: Multiple Apps - Add Two Apps via Add New
Test Steps:
1. Create first app "App One" (volume=100000)
2. Click "Add new application" and create "App Two" (volume=50000)
3. Observe Applications section
Expected Result: Both apps appear as separate cards. Heading shows "Applications (2)". Portfolio totals combine both (total volume = 150,000).

Section: Multiple Apps - Verify Portfolio Calculates Correctly
Precondition: User has two apps with different volumes
Test Steps:
1. Create "App One" with volume=100000
2. Create "App Two" with volume=50000
3. Observe portfolio totals
Expected Result: Total annual volume = 150,000 (sum of both). Parts/year = 150,000. Other KPIs calculate correctly based on combined data.

Section: Clear Selection - Removes All Apps
Precondition: User has one or more apps loaded
Test Steps:
1. Create at least one app
2. Click "Clear selection" button
Expected Result: All apps cleared from Applications section. "No applications yet." empty state returns. Portfolio totals reset to "—". Filters reset to defaults.

Section: Clear Selection - Button State (Enabled/Disabled)
Test Steps:
1. With no apps: observe Clear selection button state
2. Add an app: observe button state changes
Expected Result: Clear selection is disabled (grayed) when no apps are loaded. Becomes enabled when at least one app is loaded.

Section: Customize Assumptions - Modal Opens
Precondition: User has at least one app loaded
Test Steps:
1. Create an app
2. Click "Customize assumptions" button
3. Observe the dialog/panel
Expected Result: A modal or panel opens with heading "Customize assumptions". Fields for utilization rate, cost factors, etc. may be present. Close/Cancel button available.

Section: Customize Assumptions - Modify And Save
Test Steps:
1. Open Customize assumptions
2. Modify a value (e.g., utilization rate)
3. Click "Save" or "Apply"
Expected Result: Assumptions values are updated. Portfolio KPIs may recalculate based on new assumptions.

Section: Customize Assumptions - Cancel Without Saving
Test Steps:
1. Open Customize assumptions
2. Modify a value
3. Click "Cancel" or close button
Expected Result: Modal closes. Changes are NOT applied. Assumptions remain at previous values.

Section: Add Existing From Params Section
Test Steps:
1. Create an app first
2. Click "Clear selection"
3. Click "Add existing application" under params section (not Option B)
4. Select an app and click OK
Expected Result: Same "My applications" modal opens. App loads into params section. Functionally identical to Use Existing Application.

Section: Add New From Params Section
Test Steps:
1. Click "Add new application" under params section
2. Fill form and save
Expected Result: Same "New application" modal opens. App is created and appears in Applications section.

Section: Setup New App - Special Characters in Name
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Enter name with special chars: "Test-App #1 (OEM)"
3. Click "Save"
Expected Result: App is created with special characters. Name displays correctly on app card (no encoding issues).

Section: Setup New App - Long Name/Payload
Test Steps:
1. Click "Setup New Application"
2. Enter very long name (500+ chars)
3. Click "Save"
Expected Result: Long name is either truncated, wrapped, or rejected. No UI breaking or database error. Document behavior.

Section: Edit App - Remove All Fasteners Then Save
Precondition: User has app with one fastener
Test Steps:
1. Open edit on app with fastener
2. Remove the only fastener
3. Click "Save"
Expected Result: App is saved without fasteners. App card updates to show no fastener data.

Section: Use Existing App - Search Functionality
Precondition: Use Existing modal is open with many apps
Test Steps:
1. Open Use Existing Application modal
2. Use search/filter field in the table
3. Type app name or number
Expected Result: Table filters to show only matching apps. Search clears to restore full list.
